column1: # After the int32 unary-plus fix (40f03d1e52), with the function tier re-enabled for a test:
# ty2.js (callee does typeof) n=20245, sw4.js n=20443 s=24080297, co.js (+k callee) n=20570
# s=26684559 — every loop gains iterations, so a loop whose body calls a function that steps
# out still mis-resumes under the function tier; the tier stays off (054f5ef0ea). With it off
# all four reproducers are exact (ty2 n=20000, sw4/co s=199990000, +i sums 199990000).
# Narrowed further: with the function tier on, r1.js (`t(i); n++`, callee does typeof) gives
# n=20176 and r2.js (`s += t(i)`) s=121446 = 6*20241 — the extra count equals the loop index
# where the callout left the lane, i.e. the resumed body restarts the induction at 0. The same
# callee with more live caller values (miss2: r, shown, badr) is exact, so it depends on the
# register allocation: a live pinned int is not restored across the callout leave/resume.
# With the tier off all of these are exact (n=20000, s=120000).
